request: Start the application using the latest nm/brain components and remove active dependencies on the archived engines.

owning_boundaries.durable_storage: Existing authenticated sealed StorePort commit boundary

observable_pass_conditions: The application starts, serves account/static/chat paths and processes a turn while archived-engine imports are blocked.
A new turn calls the current label, preparation and independent review components with the complete original context.
Only owned original-source expressions become public. Draft prose and proposed activities cannot imply completed actions.
Exact input, private proposals, checked public display and their bindings save atomically and reopen without a model call.
Missing context, wrong ownership, altered source/display bindings and unconfirmed persistence cannot produce a success receipt.

issues_and_fixes.issue: The active composition still depended on removed brain modules and archived engine routes.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Compose the rebuilt brain directly, retain authenticated account and sealed storage adapters, and remove archived engine routes from the serving surface.
issues_and_fixes.scope: Current application startup, authenticated chat and saved-chat reading. Historical matters remain unchanged and unavailable to the rebuilt processing path.

issues_and_fixes.issue: The preparation result is unreviewed prose and cannot itself establish a public answer or completed effect.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Add an independent original-evidence review and a closed code-owned renderer. Public output contains a fixed greeting, selected complete original advocate messages, and a scoped notice that proposed work has not been performed.
issues_and_fixes.counterexample: A malicious draft claiming filing or completed corrections is retained privately but cannot be rendered.

issues_and_fixes.issue: Display fields outside the selected release could reopen a public prose path during replay.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Bind the entire supported response envelope to owned fixed values and the saved release. Forbid added composed prose, admitted material, board changes or continuation output in this initial contract.
issues_and_fixes.counterexample: A changed composed paragraph remains refused even if a local response digest was recomputed.

issues_and_fixes.issue: A readable history prefix or an unknown explicit chat ID could be mistaken for a complete new-message context.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Validate the contract-specific turn/version sequence, exact source reconstruction and preparation bindings. Require an explicitly referenced chat to exist under its authenticated owner.
issues_and_fixes.counterexample: Removing the last saved turn or requesting a missing chat cannot start a model call with empty history.

issues_and_fixes.issue: Partial failure status could disappear after reopening or when assembling follow-up context.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Persist service status separately from the reply, validate it against release evidence, render it separately and preserve it as NM context metadata.
issues_and_fixes.counterexample: An unsupported action peer does not erase supported information or appear silently complete.

issues_and_fixes.issue: A lost save acknowledgement cannot prove either successful saving or rollback.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Read the owned durable receipt after a save exception. Reuse a matching saved result without repeating the model stages; otherwise retain an unconfirmed status.
issues_and_fixes.counterexample: Failure injected after the atomic write returns the single saved response and leaves one stored input.

issues_and_fixes.issue: The first live greeting failed because the reviewer selected a unit identity that did not exist in the supplied preparation.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Provide applicable owned IDs in the response schema and permit one turn-owned conditional correction carrying the precise rejection and original context. No scenario-specific greeting exception is added.
issues_and_fixes.counterexample: One failed stage can use the shared allowance; later stages cannot reset it or acquire private retry loops.

purposes.label_message: Original latest message and complete prior context where present; one exclusive greeting/information/action/mixed proposal.
purposes.prepare_response: Complete original context and proposed label; private reply draft, source-linked material proposals and planned activities.
purposes.review_prepared_response: Complete original evidence before the unreviewed preparation; owned selectors, per-unit support decisions and omissions. No public prose.

offline.warning: One external deprecation warning; no skipped cases.
offline.scope: Current components, release, turn ownership/recovery, sealed storage, source layout and authenticated HTTP application.

browser.method: Real Chrome user-interface journey through Playwright CDP after the CUA driver failed twice.

turns.message: SYNTHETIC WIRING CHECK. Our client says the delivery was due on 18 November 2026. The other party denies agreeing to that date. Please plan how to compare their two accounts; do not contact either party.
Correction: our client now says 19 November, not 18 November. The other party still denies agreeing to a delivery date. Keep the earlier account visible as a correction, not as an established fact.

browser.semantic_acceptance: Incomplete. The greeting was also extracted as material. Full messages repeat under account/request and historical correction context. The browser shows no natural summary, detailed plan or executed task.
browser.final_server_reopen: Passed after final restart. No stale build banner and no browser errors.

verification.interpretation_limit: Scripted tests prove the exercised mechanics. Small live samples do not establish semantic accuracy, false-positive rates or production readiness.

remaining_work: Live preparation/review admitted a greeting as material and repeats full source messages. These semantic and conversational quality gaps are recorded, not patched with greeting keywords or case-specific rules.
Natural checked summaries and detailed activity plans are not yet published by this restricted renderer.
Facts remain proposals; admitted material records, correction reconciliation and exact relevant passage selection are not connected.
Legal research, checked legal analysis, document production and external execution are not connected.
Historical matters and retired engine routes are not reopened through the rebuilt brain.
Selective internal repair of held independent units remains separate from the single shared schema-correction allowance.
Sustained live semantic quality and production readiness remain unverified.

archive_scope.served_path: Startup and authenticated turn/reopen tests pass with nm.Archives imports forcibly blocked.
archive_scope.remaining_inactive_references: 75 archive imports remain in 37 inactive legacy files outside the served application path. Archived records and code were not deleted.
archive_scope.claim_limit: This checkpoint removes archive dependencies from the running application, not every historical reference from the repository.
